title: The Chest X-ray for Physiotherapists — Read the Report, Plan the Treatment

hook.en: Before you position a chest patient or clear secretions, the chest X-ray tells you where the problem is. Learn a simple routine, the common patterns and how they change your treatment.
hook.ur: Chest ke mareez ko position karne ya balgham saaf karne se pehle chest X-ray batati hai ke masla kahan hai. Saadi routine, aam patterns aur woh aap ka ilaj kaise badalte hain seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll check the quality of a chest X-ray, follow an ABCDE routine, recognise consolidation, collapse, effusion and pneumothorax in a report and choose safe positions and techniques.
goal.ur: End tak aap chest X-ray ki quality check karenge, ABCDE routine follow karenge, report mein consolidation, collapse, effusion aur pneumothorax pehchanenge aur mehfooz positions aur techniques chunenge.

text.en: On a chest X-ray, **air in the lungs is black**, so healthy lung fields look dark with fine white vessels. Anything that fills the air spaces (pus, fluid, collapsed lung) looks **whiter**. Always look at **the quality first**: is the patient straight (not rotated), has a good breath been taken (about six ribs at the front) and is it the right way round? Then read it in order. For physiotherapists, the question is: **what is the problem, and where?**
text.ur: Chest X-ray par **phephron ki hawa kaali** hoti hai, is liye sehatmand phephron ka hissa kaala nazar aata hai aur baareek safed naliyan. Jo bhi hawa ke khanon ko bhar de (peep, paani, pichka hua phephra) **safed** nazar aata hai. Hamesha **pehle quality** dekhein: kya mareez seedha hai (ghuma hua nahi), kya achhi saans li gayi (samne takreeban chhe pasliyan) aur kya sahi taraf hai? Phir tarteeb se parhein. Physiotherapist ke liye sawal yeh hai: **masla kya hai, aur kahan?**

text.en: Think of the lungs as **two dark rooms filled with air**. If a room fills with water (effusion), the lower part turns white and flat-topped. If a room fills with smoke (consolidation), it turns hazy white with branches of air still visible. If a room collapses like a deflated balloon, its walls shift inwards and the neighbouring room tries to fill the space. These pictures tell you how to position the patient.
text.ur: Phephron ko **hawa se bhare do andhere kamre** samjhein. Agar kamra paani se bhar jaye (effusion), neechla hissa safed aur chapta kinare wala ho jata hai. Agar dhoon se bhar jaye (consolidation), dhundla safed ho jata hai magar hawa ki shaakhein nazar aati hain. Agar kamra pichkay hue ghubaray ki tarah collapse ho jaye, deewarein andar sarakti hain aur padosi kamra jagah bharne ki koshish karta hai. Yeh tasveerein batati hain ke mareez ko kaise position karna hai.

title.en: A routine for a chest X-ray report

steps.title: Check the picture
steps.detail: Name, date, side marker; rotation (the collarbone ends should be equal distance from the spine); inspiration (about six front ribs); penetration (spine just visible behind the heart). A poor picture changes what you see. || Tasveer check karein

steps.title: A, B and C: airway, breathing, circulation
steps.detail: Is the windpipe central? Are both lungs dark and equal, with no white patch or black rim at the edge? Is the heart a normal size (less than half the chest width on a standard film)? || A, B aur C: airway, breathing, circulation

steps.title: D and E: diaphragm, everything else
steps.detail: Are the two diaphragms smooth and sharp, with the right slightly higher? Are the sharp corners (costophrenic angles) clear? Look at the ribs, collarbones, soft tissues and any tubes, lines or devices. || D aur E: diaphragm, baqi sab

steps.title: Link it to treatment
steps.detail: Match the finding to a plan: where the problem is decides the position, whether to use airway clearance and whether to mobilise. Discuss unclear or unexpected findings with the medical team. || Ilaj se jorein

question.en: Which finding suggests fluid in the pleural space?
question.ur: Kaun si finding pleural space mein paani ki taraf ishara karti hai?

text.en: A hazy white area with air tubes visible inside
text.ur: Dhundla safed hissa jis mein hawa ki naliyan nazar aayein

feedback.ur: Yeh consolidation ki taraf ishara hai.

text.en: A white area at the base with a curved upper edge and a blunted costophrenic angle
text.ur: Neechay safed hissa jis ka oopar ka kinara kamaan jaisa ho aur costophrenic angle kund

feedback.en: Yes — this is the classic look of a pleural effusion.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh pleural effusion ki khaas shakl hai.

text.en: A dark rim at the lung edge with no vessels
text.ur: Phephre ke kinare par kaali pattee jis mein naliyan nahi

feedback.ur: Yeh pneumothorax ki taraf ishara hai.

rows.en: Patchy white area, air bronchograms visible
rows.ur: Dhabbay jaisa safed hissa, air bronchograms nazar aate hain

rows.en: White area with shifted structures towards it
rows.ur: Safed hissa jis ki taraf cheezein khichti hain

rows.en: Reduced; the fissure, diaphragm or windpipe moves towards the collapse
rows.ur: Kam; fissure, diaphragm ya saans ki nali collapse ki taraf sarakti hai

rows.en: Infection with fluid and pus in the air spaces
rows.ur: Infection jis mein hawa ke khanon mein paani aur peep

rows.en: Blocked airway (mucus plug), poor breathing after surgery
rows.ur: Rukhi hui airway (balgham ka plug), surgery ke baad kamzor saans

rows.en: Positioning, mobilising, airway clearance if secretions
rows.ur: Position, harkat, balgham ho to airway clearance

rows.en: Positioning with the good lung down or up as advised, deep breathing, clearing the plug
rows.ur: Position, achha phephra neechay ya oopar mashware ke mutabiq, gehri saans, plug saaf karna

text.en: **Quality first, then ABCDE.** Never read a film before checking rotation and inspiration. Then follow the same order every time. Put the finding together with the patient's signs: breath sounds, temperature, oxygen and the story.
text.ur: **Pehle quality, phir ABCDE.** Rotation aur saans check kiye baghair film kabhi na parhein. Phir har baar wohi tarteeb. Finding ko mareez ki nishaniyon se milayein: saans ki awaaz, bukhar, oxygen aur kahani.

text.en: **Treating secretions when there are none.** A white patch is not always mucus. Fluid, pus in the air spaces or a collapsed lung may not respond to airway clearance. Treat what the patient has: check breath sounds and secretions before you apply a technique.
text.ur: **Jahan balgham nahi wahan uska ilaj.** Safed dhabba hamesha balgham nahi hota. Paani, hawa ke khanon mein peep ya pichka hua phephra airway clearance par jawab nahi dete. Mareez mein jo hai us ka ilaj karein: technique se pehle saans ki awaaz aur balgham check karein.

question.en: A patient has a large untreated pneumothorax on the chest X-ray. What should you do?
question.ur: Mareez ke chest X-ray par bara be-ilaaj pneumothorax hai. Aap kya karein?

text.en: Teach vigorous deep breathing and coughing
text.ur: Zor se gehri saans aur khansne ki mashq sikhayein

text.en: Start percussion to clear the lung
text.ur: Phephra saaf karne ke liye percussion shuru karein

feedback.en: That is not appropriate and could be harmful.
feedback.ur: Yeh munasib nahi aur nuqsandeh ho sakta hai.

text.en: Do not start treatment and tell the medical team at once
text.ur: Ilaj shuru na karein aur foran medical team ko batayein

feedback.en: Yes — this is a medical emergency that needs a chest drain.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh medical emergency hai jis ke liye chest drain chahiye.

question.en: Which position is used to help drain a lower lobe with secretions, if the patient tolerates it?
question.ur: Agar mareez bardasht kare to balgham wale neechle lobe ko drain karne ke liye kaun si position istemal hoti hai?

text.en: A head-down tilt or lying with the affected area uppermost, as the medical team allows
text.ur: Sar neechay ka jhukao ya mutasir hissa oopar rakh kar letna, jaise medical team ijazat de

feedback.en: Yes — gravity helps drainage, but head-down tilt needs medical clearance.
feedback.ur: Haan — khinchao drain mein madad karta hai, magar sar neechay ke jhukao ko medical ijazat chahiye.

text.en: Sitting upright for all lung problems
text.ur: Har phephre ke masle mein seedha baithna

feedback.en: The best position depends on the problem.
feedback.ur: Behtareen position masle par munhasir hai.

text.en: Always lying flat on the back
text.ur: Hamesha peeth ke bal seedha letna

feedback.ur: Yeh phephron ka hajm kam kar sakta hai.

text.en: **Match the film to the bedside.** Before a session read the report, check the film if you can, listen to the chest and look at oxygen levels. Where unsure, ask the doctor or radiologist, and record what you decided and why. Re-check the patient after treatment.
text.ur: **Film ko bistar ke saath milayein.** Session se pehle report parhein, mumkin ho to film dekhein, seena sunein aur oxygen level dekhein. Shak ho to doctor ya radiologist se poochhein, aur likhein ke kya faisla kiya aur kyun. Ilaj ke baad mareez ko dobara check karein.

question.en: Why are rotation and inspiration checked before anything else?
question.ur: Rotation aur saans sab se pehle kyun check hote hain?

answer.en: A rotated or under-breathed film changes how the heart, lungs and diaphragm look. A poor breath can make the lung bases look white and the heart look large, which can be mistaken for disease. Checking quality first prevents false findings.
answer.ur: Ghuma hua ya kam saans wali film dil, phephron aur diaphragm ki shakl badal deti hai. Kamzor saans phephron ke neechle hissay safed aur dil bara dikha sakti hai, jo bimari samjhi ja sakti hai. Pehle quality dekhne se ghalat findings se bacha ja sakta hai.

beats.patient: A man 2 days after abdominal surgery has a low oxygen level and shallow breathing. The chest X-ray report says "left lower lobe collapse with the left diaphragm raised". On listening, breath sounds are quiet at the left base.
beats.assessment: The picture fits post-operative collapse of the left lower lobe from poor breathing and secretion retention.
beats.treatment: Sit him up, teach deep breathing with a hold and supported coughing, mobilise early and use positioning with the left side up as allowed.
beats.reassess: The next day his oxygen improves and the breath sounds return at the left base.

text.en: **Tell the doctor straight away** for a pneumothorax (especially with breathlessness), a rapidly growing effusion, a new large white-out, a widened mediastinum after trauma, free air under the diaphragm, or tubes and lines in the wrong place. Do not apply percussion, vibration or head-down positions without clearance in unstable patients, or with rib fractures, recent haemoptysis or a raised pressure in the head.
text.ur: **Doctor ko foran batayein** pneumothorax (khaas kar saans ki tangi ke saath), tezi se barhta effusion, nayi bari safedi, trauma ke baad chauda mediastinum, diaphragm ke neechay azaad hawa, ya ghalat jagah par tubes aur lines. Ghair mustaqil mareezon, pasli ke fractures, haal ki khoon ki khansi ya sar mein barhe dabao mein ijazat ke baghair percussion, vibration ya sar neechay ki position na dein.

summary.en: Air is black and fluid or pus is white; check rotation, inspiration and penetration, then read A, B, C, D and E in the same order every time.
summary.ur: Hawa kaali aur paani ya peep safed hai; rotation, saans aur penetration check karein, phir har baar A, B, C, D aur E ek hi tarteeb mein parhein.

summary.en: Know the common patterns: consolidation, collapse, effusion and pneumothorax, and let them guide positioning and technique.
summary.ur: Aam patterns jaanein: consolidation, collapse, effusion aur pneumothorax, aur unhein position aur technique ki rehnumai karne dein.

summary.en: Match the film to the bedside, treat what the patient has, and tell the medical team about urgent findings such as pneumothorax.
summary.ur: Film ko bistar se milayein, mareez mein jo hai us ka ilaj karein, aur pneumothorax jaisi urgent findings medical team ko batayein.
